DASH — Movement Technique (Common)

A short, explosive burst of forward motion, converting stored stamina into raw speed over a very short distance.

Used correctly, a Dash closes space fast enough to beat a slow swing, or opens space fast enough that the fist meant for your jaw finds only air.

It costs stamina up front — committing to a Dash with none to spare leaves you standing still and winded exactly when you can least afford it.

Direction is set by where you are facing the instant you commit. There is no steering mid-Dash — plan the line before you move, not during.
